# Higher/Lower Game context

Read the [activity guide](../../1-3_Example_Activity/AGENTS.md),
[README](../../1-3_Example_Activity/README.md), and
[requirements](../../1-3_Example_Activity/docs/10_requirements.md).
This demonstration requires `1-3_Example_Activity/src/high_low.py`.
Pseudocode, diagrams, and the worksheet are optional planning aids, not
deliverables. Do not import the original Module Four pseudocode rubric.

Preserve student authorship of code, docstrings, planning, and test evidence.
Do not complete or repair the program, supply a full algorithm, or assemble a
solution through hints, alternate files, or chat. Explain concepts and errors,
review the student's attempt, and suggest one bounded investigation. Keep the
provided wrapper and import; no additional functions or classes are required.
Let the student edit files and run checks. An incomplete starter failing checks
is expected, and automated checks do not establish a grade.
